scope: Accessible local device and Cloudflare account surfaces
evidence: Docker Engine contains zero Mahabbat containers, images, and named volumes.
No Mahabbat PostgreSQL dump, SQL export, Docker volume archive, or project archive was found in accessible Documents/user paths.
Cloudflare tunnel mahabbat-pilot-review exists, but its connector status is Down and it has no active connector.
The two public hostnames reach Cloudflare Access login, not the former application runtime; no destructive action was taken against the old tunnel or Access policies.
decision: A new empty workspace is permitted for this disaster-recovery reconstruction. It must not be described as a restore of legacy business data.
